title: Core Validation 009D — Compositional Operator Geometry
decision_question: After carrier-effect vector geometry fails, does the full normalized write operator retain reusable joint structure that was destroyed by Ghat_i r: either sparse tensor-product coordinates inside the independently validated 56x8 factor subspace, or a train-learned relationship from compact right/address factors to broad left/effect factors?

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 009B-1/009B-2/009C causal-sequence extraction and train/eval filtering

operator_definition.per_write_rank1: best rank-1 SVD of Ghat_i; oracle diagnostic only

validated_factor_subspace.fit: train-only covariance bases exactly as Core 009A: eig(mean Ghat Ghat^T), eig(mean Ghat^T Ghat)
validated_factor_subspace.rank1_core_rule: project to 56x8 core, take best rank-1 SVD of that core, reconstruct through the shared bases

sparse_tensor_core.coding: Within the fixed train-only 56x8 orthonormal factor basis, keep the s largest-magnitude core entries. This is the exact best s-term Frobenius approximation in that fixed tensor-product dictionary.
sparse_tensor_core.atom_identity: (left basis coordinate p, right basis coordinate q)
sparse_tensor_core.matched_null: deterministic independent Haar-like orthogonal rotations within the learned 56D left and 8D right subspaces; dense projection is identical, so null isolates coordinate sparsity rather than subspace quality
sparse_tensor_core.description_bits: each active pair uses ceil(log2(56*8)) support bits plus a coefficient

right_conditioned_operator.factor_extraction: top SVD pair of each Ghat; orient right factor to have nonnegative dot with the train-only carrier and flip left factor with it
right_conditioned_operator.address: project the oriented right factor into the train-only 8D right basis
right_conditioned_operator.target: project the oriented left factor into the train-only 56D left basis
right_conditioned_operator.predictor: centered ridge regression target~address with lambda chosen by deterministic train-only 4-fold CV
right_conditioned_operator.heldout_reconstruction: predicted left factor x heldout projected-right factor, scaled by heldout top singular value; heldout left factor never enters prediction
baselines: train mean left-factor coordinate with heldout right factor
nearest train right-address neighbor's left factor
deterministically permuted train left targets with the identical ridge/CV procedure
right_conditioned_operator.interpretation: This is an operator-structure oracle because heldout right factor is extracted from Ghat; it tests whether right-side variation contains organizational information, not whether inference can recover that address.

global_baselines.vectorized_pca: train-only uncentered PCA of vec(Ghat) in R^4096
global_baselines.storage_match_reason: one dense vectorized PCA component costs 4096 shared scalars, equal to the entire 56D+8D separable factor bases

discovery.selection_rule: First require the rank1-core guard on both seeds. A sparse tensor configuration is viable only if the same s<=16 passes every sparse gate on both seeds; choose the smallest viable s. If no sparse tensor configuration is viable, right-conditioned geometry may be locked only if the single frozen train-CV ridge procedure passes every right-conditioned gate on both seeds. No per-seed family switching.

replication.formal_hardware: Kaggle GPU for frozen hidden/gradient extraction; operator geometry is CPU-safe after extraction

stop_rule.discovery_failure: Do not open confirmation or deployable routing. If only rank1 factor compression survives, natural reusable operator Cells are unsupported under 009D; pivot toward engineered mutable rank-1/low-rank Cells plus certificates/growth, unless a separately frozen nonlinear operator hypothesis is justified.
stop_rule.confirmation_failure: Do not claim natural reusable operator Cells. Preserve factor-compression diagnostics but pivot product work to engineered modules.
stop_rule.confirmation_success_sparse: Proceed to inference-visible addressability of locked operator coordinate pairs, then composition/certificate/growth validation.
stop_rule.confirmation_success_conditional: Proceed first to inference-visible recovery of the right/address coordinate; do not claim sparse Cells until a separate reuse test passes.

interpretation_boundary: 009D does not revise the negative 009B-2 or 009C scientific decisions.
A sparse-tensor positive supports reusable rank-1 operator coordinate pairs inside the validated 56x8 subspace; it does not establish semantic Cells or deployable routing.
A right-conditioned positive supports organizational information in right-side operator variation lost by Ghat r; it is not deployable because heldout right factors are oracle-extracted from Ghat.
Rank1-in-56x8 compression alone is useful compression but is not evidence of cross-write reuse.
A negative result rejects these frozen linear/separable operator hypotheses, not all nonlinear operator manifolds and not engineered adaptive modules.
